name: Monstercat Visualizer
author: Hive (look based on marcopixel/monstercat-visualizer, MIT)
description: A Visualizer page in the sidebar: Monstercat-style spectrum bars with the playing track's cover art, artist and title, in Hive's theme.

settings.label: Sensitivity (dB)
settings.description: Dynamic range shown by the bars. Lower makes quiet parts taller.

settings.label: Monstercat smoothing
settings.description: Spreads each peak to its neighbours for the classic look.

settings.label: Use Hive's accent color
settings.description: Off uses the theme's text color.
